Vivek / Ben / Ilya — reviewed the redlines overnight. High-level notes: 

1) Invoice entity: Redwood can accommodate invoicing from our US entity for the first 12 months to simplify MedTrax AP. For EU operations beyond pilot scale we recommend routing EU invoices from Redwood EU LLC. I'll mark the order form with a conditional clause: "Initial invoices by Redwood US Inc. for pilot; post-commitment invoicing entity to be determined by region and mutually agreed schedule."

2) VAT / reverse charge: the redline Ilya provided is broadly acceptable, but we need MedTrax to provide tax residency documentation (VAT registration or a signed declaration) before the clause takes effect. I'll add a short "Tax Evidence" appendix and set a 30-day evidence window. The appendix can be a checklist (country, VAT ID, supporting docs).

3) Pricing ladder carveout: I propose two edits — (a) cap the maximum per-token uplift to 15% on the first renewal year and (b) preserve our right to recommend a quantized model alternative for cost control. Both are commercial protections; let Ben know if those are acceptable.

4) Net terms: net-45 is okay but requires Finance approval for the pilot. I'll add a standard "Invoice Dispute" clause (15-day dispute window) and a late fee trigger tied to Net X nonpayment — standard language.

Ilya — attaching a tracked version with inline comments (MedTrax_OrderForm_v2_redline.docx) and a short tax-evidence template (QA_Tax_Evidence.xlsx) so your AP can start collecting.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MedTrax_OrderForm_v2_redline.docx; QA_Tax_Evidence.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>

Ilya — quick commercial reply:

- Minimum commit: we saw your request to soften the Q3 ramp in the pricing ladder. We can accept a 6-month ramp with a pro-rated minimum for the pilot (50% of the first-year ladder for months 1–6) so MedTrax isn't locked into a full-year tier immediately.
- Tier cap: Kimberly's 15% uplift cap on per-token adjustments is fine from Sales. We prefer to keep quantization/model substitution language to provide operational cost controls.
- Billing cadence: quarterly invoices + net-45 is acceptable pending Finance sign-off (we'll fast-track it).

If that all looks good, I'll prepare a clean order form (tracked-out) for signature and ping Legal to produce a DocuSign envelope. Proposed timeline: clean order form to you by EOD Monday; signature-ready DocuSign by Wed.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
